en.headline: 390 own commits and 715 automated ones across ten repos, plus 37 issue actions
en.teaser: Most of the window went into the sogeisetsu daily-report pipeline, four OpenCode plugins and a pixel-logo CLI, with issue reports filed against OpenChamber and OpenCode.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-10-09 to 2026-11-07 with data for every day. Across all repositories the totals were 390 own commits, 0 pull requests, 37 issue actions and 0 reviews, with a separate 715 automated commits recorded in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`.

### Daily report pipeline

Most of the work landed in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, which produced 113 own commits plus 715 automated commits and 6 issue actions. The daily report was reworked so that blank days no longer swallow the discussion and other extra sections, and the AI layer's duplicate empty check was removed in favour of a regression test that keeps `generateNarrative` from blocking on its own. Commit attribution now accepts aliases so commits from non-GitHub account emails are counted, and the CLI gained a `--force` flag that skips the frozen comment-count snapshot and re-fetches it for finalised days. A new AI summary of the last 30 days of GitHub activity was added as both a home-page card and a standalone page, and candidate entries are no longer filtered by whether `updated_at` falls inside the window.

### OpenCode plugins

`opencode-skill-management` received 77 commits and shipped four releases (v0.2.0, v1.0.0, v1.1.0, v1.2.0). The `skill_management` plugin was implemented and accepted with list, inspect, disable and enable actions; v1.1.0 switched all four actions to a single JSON object with an output schema, and v1.2.0 fixed the diverged-skill count and contradictory frontmatter booleans. `opencode-agent-sandbox` got 80 commits, mostly an initial commit plus a growing knowledge base covering OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture and auth, Windows path pitfalls, and corrections to stale conclusions. `opencode-go-model-picker` had 25 commits and four releases: v1.4.0 added shared JSON and proxy helpers and richer agent discovery, 2.0.0 introduced priced accounting and Console calibration, 3.0.0 cut the model-facing text by roughly 12.6 times, and 3.0.1 enforced the candidate menu and per-source chains.

### Translation and pixel art

`sopen-translate` saw 56 commits building an MV3 extension: a skeleton with page and selection translation, a provider protocol layer with presets, model lists and a glossary pipeline, bilingual page rendering with chunk splitting, a circuit breaker and progress, plus smoke tests, JSDoc type checking and a refactor that dropped selection translation in favour of page translation only. `pixel-logo-toolkit` had 29 commits and two releases: v0.2.0 was the first tagged release with a bilingual CLI and English-first docs, and v0.3.0 added automatic text wrapping, overflow protection and a full CLI manual, alongside fixes for the Korean Galmuri font and right-side decoration width.

### Upstream issue reports

No pull requests or reviews were opened. Issue activity was concentrated upstream: 20 issue actions in `openchamber/openchamber` and 11 in `anomalyco/opencode`. Reports covered the MCP settings page omitting the Console server, a stale session-retention hint, quote-card arrows doing nothing outside loaded history, unreliable line-number dragging in the files view, browser captures exporting at 1x on high-DPI displays, and MiMo vision models rejecting images on the Go endpoint. Several of these were closed by maintainers during the window.

### Smaller repositories

`asset-inventory` had 6 commits, correcting skill invocation facts across the skill, samples, guides and contributor docs and cutting v1.15.4 and v1.15.5. `myBlog` had 4 commits, all adding OpenChamber capture samples and a session-retention hint screenshot.

highlights.text: Commented on the AI narrative generation failure report.
Opened, commented on and closed a temporary opencode /oc smoke test issue.
Reported that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime.
Reported that browser captures export at CSS pixel size, half resolution on a 200% display.
Reported that MiMo models advertise image input while the Go endpoint rejects every image.
Requested a way to run the CLI that the Windows desktop ships.
First stable release of the skill_management plugin, freezing the 1.x surface.
Added automatic text wrapping, overflow protection and a full CLI manual.

zh.headline: 十个仓库共 390 次本人提交、715 次自动提交，另有 37 次 issue 互动
zh.teaser: 本窗口主要投入在日报流水线、四个 OpenCode 插件和像素 Logo 命令行工具上，同时向 OpenChamber 与 OpenCode 提交了问题报告。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-10-09 至 2026-11-07，30 天均有数据。全部仓库合计 390 次本人提交、0 个拉取请求、37 次 issue 互动、0 次评审，另有 715 次自动提交记录在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中。

### 日报流水线

工作量主要集中在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`，该仓库有 113 次本人提交，另有 715 次自动提交，以及 6 次 issue 互动。日报逻辑被重做：空白日不再吞掉 discussion 等附加段，AI 层重复的空值拦截被移除，改由回归用例锁住 `generateNarrative` 不自行拦截。提交归属支持别名，以兼容非 GitHub 账号邮箱的提交；CLI 新增 `--force`，可跳过评论数快照冻结并为已定稿日期重新抓取。新增近 30 天 GitHub 活动的 AI 总结，同时提供首页卡片和独立页面；候选条目不再按 `updated_at` 是否落在窗口内过滤。

### OpenCode 插件

`opencode-skill-management` 有 77 次提交，发布四个版本（v0.2.0、v1.0.0、v1.1.0、v1.2.0）。实现了 `skill_management` 插件并通过验收，提供 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作；v1.1.0 将四个动作统一为带输出 schema 的单个 JSON 对象，v1.2.0 修正了跨 agent 差异计数和 frontmatter 布尔值互相矛盾的问题。`opencode-agent-sandbox` 有 80 次提交，除初始提交外主要是知识库建设，覆盖 OpenCode V2 的分发、架构与认证、Windows 路径坑，并修正了若干过期结论。`opencode-go-model-picker` 有 25 次提交和四个版本：v1.4.0 增加共享的 JSON 与代理辅助函数和更完整的 agent 发现，2.0.0 引入计价核算与 Console 校准，3.0.0 把模型需要阅读的文本缩减约 12.6 倍，3.0.1 强制候选菜单与按来源的链长。

### 翻译与像素图

`sopen-translate` 有 56 次提交，搭建 MV3 扩展：页面与划词翻译骨架、带预设和模型列表的协议层与术语表流水线、双语页面渲染与分块、熔断与进度，并补充冒烟测试、JSDoc 类型检查，最后重构为只保留页面翻译。`pixel-logo-toolkit` 有 29 次提交和两个版本：v0.2.0 是首个带标签的版本，提供双语 CLI 与英文优先文档；v0.3.0 增加自动折行、溢出保护和完整 CLI 手册，并修正韩语 Galmuri 字体与右侧装饰宽度问题。

### 上游问题报告

本窗口没有拉取请求，也没有评审。issue 活动集中在上游：`openchamber/openchamber` 20 次 issue 互动，`anomalyco/opencode` 11 次。报告内容包括设置页 MCP 遗漏运行时添加的 Console 服务器、过期的会话保留提示、引用卡片箭头在历史未加载时无反应、文件视图按行号拖选不可靠、高分屏下浏览器截图只导出 1x，以及 MiMo 视觉模型在 Go 端点拒绝图片。其中若干条已被维护者关闭。

### 其他仓库

`asset-inventory` 有 6 次提交，修正了 skill 调用方式在规则、样例、指南和贡献文档中的表述，并发布 v1.15.4 与 v1.15.5。`myBlog` 有 4 次提交，全部是添加 OpenChamber 截图样例和会话保留提示截图。

highlights.text: 在 AI 叙述生成失败的报告下发表了评论。
新开、评论并关闭了一个临时的 opencode /oc 冒烟测试 issue。
报告设置页 MCP 遗漏了 OpenCode 在运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器。
报告浏览器截图按 CSS 像素导出，在 200% 缩放下只有一半分辨率。
报告 MiMo 模型宣称支持图片输入，但 Go 端点拒绝所有图片。
请求为 Windows 桌面版自带的 CLI 提供运行入口。
skill_management 插件的首个稳定版，冻结 1.x 的接口范围。
新增自动折行、溢出保护和完整的 CLI 手册。
